text: Without intuitive consumer access points comparable to iTunes, decentralized systems cannot reach mainstream consumer adoption, because users currently must manage their own security, keys, and wallets.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - Past, Present, and Future (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411897
abstract: Without such intuitive consumer support access points, it is difficult to see how decentralized systems can ever reach mainstream consumer adoption.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: current decentralized system requirements that force users to manage keys
